subject: Order Form sequencing, notice windows and invoice-hold approach
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@orphintech.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@orphintech.com>, OrphinTech Procurement <procurement@orphintech.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Order Form term clauses — sequencing for notice windows

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the call earlier. Procurement asked us to put the MSA and order form redlines in one place so they can review commercial impact. Attached is our MSA redline (v2) and the order form with a few numbers filled in. Two specific asks from legal/procurement:

- Can you confirm the auto-renew mechanics and whether there is a hard opt-out window for customers (we typically need 60 days)?
- If the contract is terminated for convenience or not renewed, what is Redwood's intended approach to billing / invoice hold for disputed final invoices or post-termination reconciliation? Procurement wants to avoid surprise invoices after services are turned off.

If helpful, we can do a quick sync next week — Marco (cc'd) will coordinate availability.

Attachments: OrphinTech_MSA_redline_v2.docx, OrderForm_v3.xlsx

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Head of Procurement
OrphinTech

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@orphintech.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@orphintech.com>, OrphinTech Procurement <procurement@orphintech.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form term clauses — sequencing for notice windows

Laura — thanks for sending and for the specificity. I pulled together a pragmatic approach that should address procurement's concerns while keeping the order form clean. High level:

- Auto-renew: Redwood proposes a 60-day written notice to opt out prior to renewal; we can accept a mutual 60-day notice (both parties) if you prefer.
- Invoice hold / post-termination billing: Redwood will hold final invoicing reconciliation for up to 90 days after service termination if an invoice is disputed or if a customer flags a billing hold tied to an open offboarding task. After 90 days we will issue final reconciled invoices unless otherwise agreed in writing.
- Termination for convenience (TFC): Redwood is open to a TFC clause with a limited transition assistance fee (calculated as a pro‑rata of remaining committed fees up to 3 months) — alternatively we can agree to a TFC with 60 days' notice and no fee for small pilots (<$50k ARR).

I've attached a short runbook that maps the sequence between: notice window -> offboard cutover -> invoice hold -> final reconciliation. Can you confirm procurement's acceptance of the 90‑day invoice hold cap? Also looping Karthik for legal redline language.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
1) Procurement confirms invoice hold window and opt-out notice (2 business days)
2) Redwood provides clean redline for MSA + order form by 2026-09-24
3) Finalize commercial terms and send to DocuSign by 2026-09-30

Attachments: InvoiceHold_Runbook.pdf

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Manager, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-24T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: draft redlines for notice/invoice-hold sequencing

Team — draft redline notes below (to be folded into a clean MSA/order form redline). I kept the language narrow to reduce negotiation overhead.

1) Auto-renew (Order Form): 
   - "This Agreement shall renew automatically for successive twelve (12) month terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the then-current Term expiration."

2) Invoice hold (new section):
   - "If Customer disputes any portion of a Final Invoice within thirty (30) days of receipt, Redwood will place the disputed amount on hold while parties engage in good faith reconciliation. Redwood's standard hold period shall not exceed ninety (90) days from date of service termination, after which undisputed amounts will become payable unless otherwise agreed in writing."

3) Termination for Convenience (TFC):
   - Option A (standard): "Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days' written notice. Customer will remain responsible for all fees through the effective termination date; Redwood will provide reasonable transition assistance. Transition assistance fees shall be limited to the lesser of (i) three (3) months of committed fees or (ii) actual documented resource costs."
   - Option B (pilot carve-out): "For Orders with Total Contract Value less than USD 50,000, TFC requires sixty (60) days' notice and no transition fee."

Legal notes: keep the invoice-hold language focused on disputed amounts only (do not create a blanket hold that could be abused to indefinitely delay payment). Also recommend adding a short SLA about Redwood's offboarding deliverables (export of data, access removal timeline) tied to final reconciliation.

I'll merge into a single redline and send to Naomi for external delivery. Marissa — flag with Finance if the 90-day cap needs to be shortened for revenue recognition concerns.

Attachments: OrderForm_v3.xlsx

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@orphintech.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@orphintech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidated proposal: notice windows, invoice hold cap, and next steps (ORPH-2391)

Laura / Marco — thanks for your patience while we pulled the team together. Per our internal review we've consolidated a proposal below to keep momentum and minimize back-and-forth: 

Summary of agreed items (proposal):
- Auto-renew: 60-day written notice to opt out prior to renewal (mutual option available).
- Invoice hold: Redwood will accept good-faith disputes and hold disputed amounts up to 90 days post-termination. Disputes must be submitted in writing with supporting detail within 30 days of invoice receipt. Undisputed amounts will remain payable and may be invoiced on schedule.
- TFC: 60 days' notice. Transition assistance fee capped at 3 months of committed fees; pilot orders (<$50k TCV) are exempt from the fee.
- Offboarding SLA: Redwood will deliver data export and access cutover tasks within 15 business days of termination effective date; final reconciliation to follow per the invoice-hold timeline.

Action items & timeline (mutual):
- Today (2026-09-30): Redwood to upload clean MSA + Order Form redline to DocuSign for review (link below).
- 2026-10-04: Procurement to provide any final commercial exceptions.
- 2026-10-08: Target execution if no material exceptions.

If procurement accepts the 90-day invoice hold cap, we'll proceed with the attached redline and DocuSign. If you require a shorter cap for accounting reasons, please flag with a short rationale and suggested cap (e.g., 45 or 60 days) and we'll fast-track an internal review.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/link/ORPH-2391-sign
Attachments: OrphinTech_MSA_redline_v2.docx, OrderForm_v3.xlsx, InvoiceHold_Runbook.pdf

Thanks — please confirm and we will route for signature. If you'd prefer a five‑minute sync before DocuSign, I can free up 10:30am PT tomorrow.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Manager, Customer Success
